summary: CreatorOS MVP — full backend + frontend e2e verified. 14/14 pytest cases pass. All 8 review-request backend endpoints work. All 8 review-request frontend flows verified in Playwright. Primary AI feature (POST /api/idea-lab) returns real, specific Claude Sonnet 4.6 output (concept + 4 titles + 3 hooks + 5 beats). Opportunity why_bullets and trend explanation are real LLM output referencing exact seed numbers (124K subs, 267% momentum). Deterministic score for opp-1 = 92 exactly. LLM cache: cached opp-1 hit measured ~200-400ms round-trip. No blocked or unverified features.
ai_features_verdicts: primary: POST /api/idea-lab (opp-1) - pass - evidence: 200 OK; concept 476 chars starting 'Alex runs a real 30-day experiment replacing his first hire — a part-time content assistant'; titles[4]=['I Replaced My Employee With AI for 30 Days','30-Day Log: AI Agent vs. My First Hire','What Happens When You Fire Staff for AI','I Let AI Run My Business for 30 Days']; hooks[3] all >0 chars; structure[5] beats with Days 1-3, 4-10, 11-20, 21-28, Day 30; not echo of source title - skill: ai-testing-llm

GET /api/opportunities/opp-1 (LLM why_bullets) - pass - evidence: 200 OK; 4 bullets referencing '2.4x baseline', '267% momentum', 'saturation score 18', '124,000 solo-founder subscribers' — matches seed numbers exactly - skill: ai-testing-llm

GET /api/trends/ai-agents (LLM explanation) - pass - evidence: 200 OK; explanation.why references 'GPT-4 and Claude', 'capability threshold', 'autonomous, multi-step task execution'; related=3 items; audience 1 sentence; linked_opportunity_id=='opp-2' - skill: ai-testing-llm
LLM cache (opp-1 second hit) - pass - evidence: cached response validated <2000ms, actual ~200-400ms from preview edge
critical_code_review_comments: server.py root endpoint returns extra 'data_mode' field beyond spec's {service:'CreatorOS'} — non-breaking, tests pass since we only asserted service key.

OpportunityDetail.jsx: 'How was this calculated?' panel opens by default (open=true initial). Review request phrasing ('toggle expands to show') implies collapsed-by-default UX; consider open=false if the intended UX is a progressive disclosure. Functionally fine either way.

compute_opportunity_score is invoked twice on each list request (once for score, then get_opportunities embeds trend via list-comp) — negligible for demo, but could be cached per opp id if data grows.
collab-proposal endpoint always returns status:'sent' regardless of validation — Pydantic ProposalRequest requires the 3 keys, so missing keys return 422; acceptable for demo.
seed_data_creation: None — used seeded creators alex-morgan, sarah-chen and 5 opportunities/8 trends already present via seed_data.py. Created one TEST_ proposal doc via /api/collab-proposal (idempotent, no side effect).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend LLM outputs are mongo-cached (llm_cache collection) after first hit. Idea-lab, opp why_bullets, and trend explanation are cached — subsequent test runs will return in ~200-400ms without invoking Claude. If schema of LLM cache is touched or key is rotated, drop the collection to force fresh calls: `mongosh test_database --eval 'db.llm_cache.drop()'`. Default preview URL: https://opportunity-feed-6.preview.emergentagent.com. pytest.ini pins -n 2 loadscope.
